items.title: Analyst turns more bullish on hardware stocks as ‘chipflation’ accelerates demand
items.summary: Investing.com -- Morgan Stanley has turned more constructive on IT hardware, upgrading its industry view as it argued that memory "chipflation" is accelerating infrastructure demand rather than delaying it.

items.title: HPE Stock Jumps After Morgan Stanley Upgrade — Analyst Admits ‘We’ve Been On The Wrong Side’ Of The Enterprise Hardware Trade
items.summary: Morgan Stanley also upgraded its broader U.S. IT Hardware industry view to In-Line from Cautious, citing evidence that the current hardware cycle is being driven by refreshes, pull-forwards and AI demand.

items.title: HPE stock surges 5% as Morgan Stanley upgrades, pointing to ~30% upside
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of HP Enterprise (NYSE: HPE) caught a major tailwind in Monday’s pre-market session, jumping 5% after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock from "Equalweight" to "Overweight."

items.title: Super Micro Computer Continues Its 3-Month Fall: One Wall Street Bull’s Thesis Predicts 55% Upside From Here
items.summary: SMCI has shed a third of its value over the past year while AI server peers rip to record highs, yet one Wall Street bull is doubling down with a target that implies massive recovery. Here is what has to go right, and what could go very wrong.

items.title: Cisco Stock Is Finally Pricing In A New Growth Story
items.summary: Management put a much higher number on its future, and the stock has been on a tear ever since. But is this a fleeting AI boom or a fundamental rewiring of the business.

items.title: Rigetti Stock Rises as Major Quantum Orders Fuel Growth
items.summary: Rigetti Computing posts a second-quarter adjusted per-share loss that meets analysts’ expectations and slightly higher revenue than expected.

items.title: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold SMCI Stock Before Q4 Earnings?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer heads into Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings with AI infrastructure demand, delayed deployment conversions and margin pressure in focus.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Followed Its Chip Orders, Not Its Headlines
items.summary: The case for the run sat in chip commitments and unrecognized product revenue quarters before Arista Networks stock caught up.
